description: Estimated pregnancy due date from the first day of the last period (Naegele's rule, adjusted for cycle length 20–45 days), the conception date, or an IVF embryo transfer date (day-3 or day-5 embryo). Also gives the estimated conception date, full-term date, how far along you are on a given day (weeks + days, trimester, days to go) and a dated timeline of common milestones (weeks 4–42), optionally with Hijri dates. Estimate only, not medical advice. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/due-date/

cycleLength.description: lmp: average cycle length in days (default 28).

date.description: The date for that method, YYYY-MM-DD.

hijri.description: Also give Umm al-Qura Hijri dates.

ivfEmbryoDay.description: ivf: embryo age at transfer, day 3 or day 5.

method.description: lmp = first day of last period; conception; ivf = embryo transfer date.

today.description: Work out progress on this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

name: calc_due_date
title: Pregnancy due date
